scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy && npm run minify:html && npm run minify:css
scripts.minify:html: find dist -type f -name '*.html' -exec sh -c 'for f do npx html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-optional-tags --remove-attribute-quotes --minify-css true --minify-js true -o "$f.min" "$f" && mv "$f.min" "$f"; done' sh {} +
scripts.minify:css: find dist -type f -name '*.css' -exec sh -c 'for f do npx cleancss -o "$f.min" "$f" && mv "$f.min" "$f"; done' sh {} +
